name: hcportal_savePermissionMatrix
description: Saves the GLOBAL grants for one grantor (Permissions V2 editor): replaces the grantor's global RolePermission rows with the supplied granted function keys, then recompiles the JSON projections (nonApi_compilePermissionMatrix) in the same transaction. Auth via ValidatePortalAuth; caller must hold HC.PlatformAdmin.CanManagePermissions.

parameters.name: functionKeys
parameters.description: GLOBAL scope: '|'-delimited granted FunctionKey list. Empty = grantor grants nothing.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: When set, edits that kennel's override (tri-state) instead of the global default.

parameters.name: revokedKeys
parameters.description: KENNEL scope: '|'-delimited force-revoke (-1) FunctionKey list. Functions in neither list inherit global.

sideEffects: Replaces the grantor's global grant rows (KennelId NULL) in HC.RolePermission
Recompiles HC.ServerStatus.PermissionMatrixJson + per-kennel HC.Kennel.PermissionOverrideJson and bumps the watermark
breakingChangeRules: Never change the Success/ErrorMessage envelope shape
